enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to side. Sleep. Adjust pillow. Turn to other side. Continue sleeping.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Wash face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Put eggs on plate. Pick up fork. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Put dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to office. Sit at desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on computer. Log in. Open patient files. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Walk back to desk. Write notes. Answer phone. Attend meeting.
Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Dispose of tray. Walk back to office. Check phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: See patients. Update records. Consult with doctor. Administer treatment. Write prescriptions. Attend team meeting. Review lab results. Talk to patient family. Walk to different departments. Use computer. Answer calls. Prepare reports.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Open door. Enter home. Close door.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Put food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Put dishes in sink.

Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Pick up phone. Scroll. Put down phone. Get up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to couch. Sit down. Turn off TV.
Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Log in. Open browser. Check email. Type email. Send email. Browse internet. Watch video. Close browser. Shut down computer.
Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Close book. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Adjust lamp. Get up. Stretch. Sit down.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Apply moisturizer. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.
Walk to bedroom. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Pull back blanket. Lie in bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Sleep.
